_about.requirement: R-111 — each role shows its definition on demand. Definitions are content records, not hardcoded strings.
_about.open_decision: D-03 — the exact role definitions on the financial-capital side come from a published model. Shipped here marked provisional, as §12 requires.

source.human_capital_definitions: Quoted verbatim from the manual's household-model section, the callout beginning 'The four roles apply to human capital as well as to instruments, and the two sides are substitutes.'
source.financial_capital_definitions: Derived verbatim from the manual's §11.4 rule: 'A block rising with the environment is Gain; paying in crisis is Protection; peaking in contraction is Stabilisation; paying a steady distribution is Income.'

naming.note: The manual's canonical financial-capital role is `Gain`, not `Growth`. Its glossary states: 'Roles (4): Gain, Income, Stabilisation, Protection. What an instrument is *for*, not what it is. Any `Growth` label maps to `Gain` at the boundary.' The build specification's §4 enum uses `growth`. Those are reconciled rather than chosen between: `growth` stays the stored key, and `Gain` is the display name on the financial-capital side only. The human-capital side is called Growth in the manual itself.

language.en: verbatim from the source above where marked, and authoritative
language.de: REVIEWED by Nicolas Bürkler on 30 August 2026. The four labels were corrected (A21) and all eight definitions read and signed off, with three corrections applied: währenddessen for the ungrammatical 'während ihm'; absolviert for gemacht; and the plural Schwankungen. The de_draft flags below are cleared accordingly.

_about.forbidden: R-143 / principle 10 — no mountain vocabulary in any of these strings, in either language. No Berg, Gipfel, Hütte, Tour, summit, climb, altitude.

roles._de_reviewed: Wertsteigerung, chosen by Nicolas Bürkler on 30 August 2026 over the draft 'Zuwachs'. It reads unambiguously as financial and keeps the Gain/Growth distinction the manual maintains at the boundary: Wachstum on the human side, Wertsteigerung on the financial one.

human.en: The activity with the highest leverage on future earning — the profession being built, the qualification being taken, the venture being started.
human.de: Die Tätigkeit mit der grössten Hebelwirkung auf das künftige Einkommen — der Beruf, der aufgebaut wird, die Ausbildung, die absolviert wird, das Unternehmen, das gegründet wird.

financial.en: A holding that rises with the environment.
financial.de: Eine Anlage, die mit dem Umfeld steigt.

roles._de_reviewed: Einkommen on BOTH sides, chosen by Nicolas Bürkler on 30 August 2026 over the draft 'Ertrag'. Deliberately the same word for both kinds of capital: Income is Income, whether it comes from employment or from a holding. Noted because the drafting had used different terms to keep the two tellable apart, and this overrides that on purpose — R-114 shows both kinds together anyway, and the capital-type column already distinguishes them.

human.en: The dependable mandate or employment that pays the bills now.
human.de: Das verlässliche Mandat oder die Anstellung, die heute die Rechnungen bezahlt.

financial.en: A holding that pays a steady distribution.
financial.de: Eine Anlage, die eine stetige Ausschüttung zahlt.

roles._de_reviewed: Stabilisierung, confirmed by Nicolas Bürkler on 30 August 2026. The role is about what a holding or an activity does, not what it is, so the noun of action is right on both sides.

human.en: Smaller, unrelated earning streams that reduce the variance of the whole.
human.de: Kleinere, voneinander unabhängige Einkommensquellen, die die Schwankungen des Ganzen verringern.

financial.en: A holding that peaks in contraction — it pays before the damage, not during it.
financial.de: Eine Anlage, die in der Kontraktion am stärksten ist — sie zahlt vor dem Schaden, nicht währenddessen.

roles._de_reviewed: Absicherung, corrected from the draft 'Schutz' by Nicolas Bürkler on 30 August 2026. Schutz is the general word for protection; Absicherung is the term of art for the role, and the one the product uses.

human.en: What keeps a person functioning so the other three continue: health, network, the activity not done for money.
human.de: Was einen Menschen funktionsfähig hält, damit die anderen drei weiterlaufen: Gesundheit, Netzwerk, die Tätigkeit, die nicht des Geldes wegen geschieht.

financial.en: A holding that pays in crisis — it pays exactly when nothing else does, and costs you something the rest of the time.
financial.de: Eine Anlage, die in der Krise zahlt — sie zahlt genau dann, wenn nichts anderes zahlt, und kostet die übrige Zeit etwas.

substitution_note.en: The two kinds of capital are substitutes, not two separate lists. That is a product-level commitment from the Journey design, and the manual states it has to be in the mathematics or it is decoration.
substitution_note.de: Die beiden Arten von Kapital ersetzen einander, sie sind nicht zwei getrennte Listen. Das ist eine Festlegung auf Produktebene aus dem Journey-Entwurf, und das Manual hält fest, dass sie in der Mathematik stehen muss, sonst ist sie Dekoration.
substitution_note.requirement: R-114 / principle 9 — where a figure exists in both kinds of capital, both are shown together.
substitution_note._de_status: STILL A DRAFT. The eight role definitions were reviewed on 30 August 2026; this note was not — it was `null` at the time and had nothing to review. It is not rendered anywhere yet.
